responsibility: Provides the main body of shared front-end support for all C-family languages. It owns many common global trees and option state, initializes builtin and standard types, supplies reusable semantic helpers for expressions, declarations, initializers, and diagnostics, mediates front-end interactions with preprocessing and target hooks, and includes utility transformations such as converting braced character-array initializers into STRING_CSTs plus common early-debug emission and other cross-language services declared in c-common.h.
same_name_distinction: Runtime implementation for shared C-family support: unlike c-common.h, it defines the common globals and executable helpers used by front ends, and unlike c-common.def, it is not declarative tree-code metadata but the code that initializes and applies those shared facilities.
